rationale: B01 is an aggregate fair-value completeness flag. In the raw June 30 schedule, the 13 debt/private-credit investment rows each have a fair value, and those row fair values sum to the source Total Debt Investments fair value of 82,691,082. The apparent 16-row residual comes from treating schedule structure and out-of-scope lines as leaves, including industry headers, blank/continuation rows, issuer subtotals, total rows, cash equivalents, short-term investments, and net asset lines. The source therefore supports the extracted private-credit fair-value coverage and makes the B01 denominator a classification/lookthrough false alarm.
